svg.text: the only path from devices to clinical applications
• Default deny between zones; only the numbered conduits (C1–C12) are
• Every conduit is authenticated, encrypted and logged to the SIEM.
• Solid arrow = permitted data flow (arrow shows who initiates).
• Dashed arrow = administrative, one-way or telemetry-only flow.
• Each zone has one policy authority (Section 5.2).
